about: Brantford is on the Grand River in southwestern Ontario, between Hamilton and London. It grew as a canal and manufacturing town and is often called the Telephone City for Alexander Graham Bell’s early work here. Six Nations of the Grand River lies immediately to the south. About 105,000 people live in Brantford.
seoSummary: Grand River city in southwestern Ontario, known as the Telephone City.
